OceanaGold Drill Results at Didipio Confirm Continuity at Depth and New Resource Potential
VANCOUVER, BC, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- OceanaGold Corporation (TSX: OGC) (NYSE: OGC) ("OceanaGold" or the "Company") announces exploration results from its exploration and resource conversion drilling programs at the Didipio Mine ("Didipio") located in the Philippines, including results on the True Blue target which is located 800 metres ("m") from Didipio and represents a potential opportunity for resource growth. These results will support an update to Didipio's Mineral Resources estimate at year-end 2026 and demonstrate the extension of gold-copper mineralization below the current resource shell, where the deposit remains open at depth.
